 Most recent Most popular INJURY TIME published at 14:22 GMT 14:22 GMT 
 Leeds 1-0 Tottenham 
 Great save by James Trafford as he dives across to push away Jan Paul van Hecke's header from a free-kick.
 We're into the first of four minutes of stoppage time.
 301 46 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Tottenham have been too safe' published at 14:22 GMT 14:22 GMT 
 Leeds 1-0 Tottenham 
 Michael Brown 
Former Tottenham and Leeds midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Tottenham have waited such a long time, their energy levels have been far too safe this second half. 
 It's whether they have enough to get through this stubborn Leeds United outfit. 
 146 83 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 14:20 GMT 14:20 GMT 
 Leeds 1-0 Tottenham 
 Harry Wilson is blocked off by Sandro Tonali as he threatened to lead a counter and Tonali is booked.

 get involved Get Involved published at 14:19 GMT 14:19 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Been all Leeds this half and they’ve got their deserved lead. There’s more goals for them in this match too, Spurs so open for the counter.
 Rich, Southam 
 550 234 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:18 GMT 14:18 GMT 
 Leeds 1-0 Tottenham 
 It looks like the Leeds United fans enjoyed that goal.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 735 271 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:18 GMT 14:18 GMT 
 Leeds 1-0 Tottenham 
 Time is running out for Tottenham to get something from this game with four minutes of normal time remaining.
 315 120 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:17 GMT 14:17 GMT 
 Leeds 1-0 Tottenham 
 Dominic Calvert-Lewin has the chance to make it 2-0 as he gets behind the Tottenham defence. He's into the box but has allowed his marker to catch up and cut off the angle and the attack comes to nothing. 
 226 255 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 14:15 GMT 14:15 GMT 
 Leeds 1-0 Tottenham 
 Tottenham react to falling behind by making a change as 18-year-old Luca Williams-Barnett is on for Mohammed Kudus.
 431 166 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Leeds needed that' published at 14:14 GMT 14:14 GMT 
 Leeds 1-0 Tottenham 
 Michael Brown 
Former Tottenham and Leeds midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Noah Okafor is so quick, he's just come onto the pitch.
 It's onto his right foot and once he's in the penalty area he's got far too much room. 
 The pace and accuracy from him, he took his chance and he and Leeds certainly needed that. 
 840 249 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:13 GMT 14:13 GMT 
 Leeds 1-0 Tottenham 
 Noah Okafor had only been on the pitch for 97 seconds before scoring.
 Impact.
 861 282 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:12 GMT 14:12 GMT 
 Leeds 1-0 Tottenham 
 Tottenham felt there was a handball in the build up. VAR had a look but the goal stands. 
 Leeds lead with 10 minutes to go.
 686 287 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Leeds 1-0 Tottenham published at 14:11 GMT 14:11 GMT 
 Noah Okafor (79 mins) 
 The substitute strikes!
 Noah Okafor has just come off the bench and he has an immediate impact. A thow-in is headed on by Dominic Calvert-Lewin, Harry Wilson pushes the ball into Okafor's path and he drives home.
 Image source, Getty Images Image source, Reuters 
 2672 1003 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Wonderful save from Kinsky' published at 14:10 GMT 14:10 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Michael Brown 
Former Tottenham and Leeds midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 It was a wonderful save from Antonin Kinsky.
 More set pieces from Leeds now, the atmosphere is mounting. We need a goal here. 
 When you have this momentum at Elland Road you have to take your chances. 
 378 100 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 14:09 GMT 14:09 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Leeds make a double change now as Ao Tanaka and Lukas Nmecha are replaced by Harry Wilson and Noah Okafor.
 336 90 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 14:08 GMT 14:08 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 This has Jayden Bogle last minute winner written all over it.
 Josh, Huntingdon 
 544 454 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GREAT SAVE! published at 14:07 GMT 14:07 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Lovely control and shot on the turn by Sean Longstaff but his effort is superbly pushed over the bar by Antonín Kinsky. Great shot and great save.
 430 74 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Leeds have reacted' published at 14:04 GMT 14:04 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Michael Brown 
Former Tottenham and Leeds midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 That Conor Gallagher strike was a wonderful clean effort, but Leeds have reacted.
 375 162 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:03 GMT 14:03 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Jayden Bogle has a couple of shots blocked from the corner before sending a third effort over.
 There's half a shout for a penalty for one of the blocked efforts but nothing is given.
 182 139 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:02 GMT 14:02 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Antonín Kinsky takes too long with a goal kick and Leeds are given a corner.
 Tottenham will kick themselves if Leeds score from this...
 292 204 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 14:00 GMT 14:00 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Some Tottenham fans think their side is ahead as Conor Gallagher drives in a decent shot from distance. The ball flies just wide of the post, but some Spurs supporters thought it was in.
